photos.title: Candlelit autumn dining table
photos.description: Warm candlelit autumn dining table: tall taper candles, wheat and pine cones in a white pitcher, woven chargers and checked linens in a bright home dining room. A close table-level composition; no turkey on the table.

photos.title: Gold and evergreen Christmas tree with garlanded mantel
photos.description: An elegant bright living room: a tall tree glowing with warm-white lights and champagne-gold ornaments beside a white mantel with lit evergreen garland, a gold-framed mirror and stacked birch logs. Real interior photograph (landscape crop of a portrait original); no snow, no people, no readable text. A decorative wall clock with numerals appears at the upper right.

photos.title: Porch glowing with jack-o-lanterns at dusk
photos.description: A white American front-porch house at dusk with glowing jack-o-lanterns on the rail and lawn, bunting and string lights; no characters or gore. The house number was blurred.

photos.title: Gold and warm-white lights with metallic decor
photos.description: Gold tinsel curtain, fairy lights, a round mirror and a table of gold baubles, pine cones and dried grasses in warm light. No text or branded items.

photos.title: Sunlit living room
photos.description: A bright, uncluttered, sunlit modern living room with large windows onto a flower garden, warm rug and natural wood. A wall-mounted air conditioner was blurred.

photos.title: White colonial with picket fence
photos.description: White colonial with picket fence. Wood picket fence crosses the lower facade; small year-round wreath by the door.

photos.title: Brick Georgian with white portico
photos.description: Brick Georgian with white portico. Seasonal mums in planters at the portico; dark SUV parked in the driveway.
